name: Cyberimpact – Email Marketing Integrations
author: Cyberimpact

sections.description:
The Cyberimpact Integration plugin connects your WordPress site to the Cyberimpact API, enabling effortless integration with popular form builders like Avada Forms, Contact Form 7, and Gravity Forms. With this plugin, you can easily add a Cyberimpact opt-in or double opt-in checkbox to your forms, allowing users to subscribe directly to your Cyberimpact contact lists.

This plugin requires a valid Cyberimpact API key to function, which can be obtained through a Cyberimpact subscription. For more details, please refer to Cyberimpact’s Terms and Conditions.

Key Features:
– Seamless integration with Avada Forms, Contact Form 7, and Gravity Forms.
– Add Cyberimpact opt-in checkboxes directly to your forms.
– Automatically add new subscribers to your Cyberimpact contact lists.
– Customizable form field mapping to ensure accurate data submission.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire cyberimpact-email-marketing-integrations folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in your WordPress admin (Plugins > Installed Plugins).
  3. Once activated, navigate to the Cyberimpact menu in your WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Enter your Cyberimpact API key in the plugin settings.
  5. Configure your forms (Avada Forms, Contact Form 7, Gravity Forms) to include a Cyberimpact opt-in or double opt-in checkbox, and map the relevant form fields to your Cyberimpact contact fields.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Cyberimpact account to use this plugin?

Yes, you will need a valid Cyberimpact account with an API key to use this plugin.

Is the Cyberimpact API key required for all functionality?

Yes, the API key is necessary to connect your forms to the Cyberimpact service and manage your contacts.

Can I use this plugin with any form builder?

Currently, the plugin supports Avada Forms, Contact Form 7, and Gravity Forms. Support for additional form builders may be added in future updates in 2026.
